subject.title: fix(ui): explain grayed-out rows in the new-session folder picker

question: Should this PR follow the documented `en.ts`-only workflow with the locale gate repaired or bypassed for post-merge generation, or should authenticated generated locale output be committed in this PR?
rationale: The scoped UI policy and the required CI gate currently demand incompatible outcomes, so maintainer intent is needed rather than asking the contributor to violate one side.

options.title: Preserve English-only workflow
options.body: Update or rerun the locale gate so source-only English keys pass and `control-ui-locale-refresh` owns generated translations after merge.

options.title: Generate locales before merge
options.body: Run authenticated locale sync and commit all generated bundles and metadata in this PR, intentionally overriding the normal scoped policy for this change.

recommendation.title: Preserve English-only workflow
recommendation.body: Update or rerun the locale gate so source-only English keys pass and `control-ui-locale-refresh` owns generated translations after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the affected feature lineage and authored this maintainer-labeled PR, making them the best available owner for its landing path.
